text:
Ravi P: Quick sync  we need to settle internal transport for model routing. Two paths: proto-first gRPC inside cluster with JSON edge, or JSON everywhere. Key concerns: routing policy, quota keys, console labels, and rollout UX.

Jules: Proto-first gives lower CPU for parsing and native metadata for model_variant/batch_size. Easier to enforce per-method routing rules.

Marta (PM): Console needs stable, human-friendly route ids that survive service refactors. Also a canary view: compare baseline vs canary for the same logical route.

Theo: Suggest gateway injects X-Rdwd-Canonical with values like inference.chat.completions.v1. That header is authoritative for telemetry and quota. Strip incoming header and gateway overwrites after auth.

Ravi P: Ownership question: who maintains the mapping of paths/methods to canonical labels? Gateway rulebook or service owners?

Jules: Gateway-owned mapping is operationally simpler. Add CI validation where services assert the canonical they expect is present. Prevents drift.

Marta (PM): For quotas we need tenant|canonical_route as the key. Product wants both soft alerts and hard reject limits per tenant per route. Cardinality will grow but acceptable.

Theo: Implementation notes: Envoy filter or Lua to compute canonical from :path or grpc-method and set header. Also propagate canonical into tracing tags.

Jules: Example pseudo Lua: 
```lua
function envoy_on_request(r)
  local p = r:headers()[":path"]
  local c = route_map[p] or p
  r:headers():replace('x-rdwd-canonical', c)
end
```

Marta (PM): During migration show both canonical and legacy labels in console charts to help teams reconcile.

Ravi P: Rollout UX: route stays canonical; model variant is an attribute under it. Console can show variant splits and p95 by variant. Token accounting stays at tenant+canonical level.

Jules: Also need header <-> grpc-metadata bridge for non-HTTP transports. Add small middleware to copy header to metadata and vice versa.

eng-deploy-bot: Canary deploy: proto-facade-spike v0.2 -> canary (4/4) :white_check_mark: metrics streaming

Theo: Action items: Jules prototype envoy transform + middleware. I'll extend telemetry schema for canonical_route and legacy_route tags. Marta will mock console migration UX. Ravi will design quota key format and storage impact.

Marta (PM): Timeline: 4-day spike. Demo next week with browser->gateway->gRPC service showing p95, token-cost, and variant split. Ticket created: https://go/infra/279001-proto-facade (placeholder).

Ravi P: Thanks, team.
